mwoauth-rest-param-desc-response_type: The OAuth 2.0 response type: code for authorization code flow.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-client_id: The client ID (consumer key) of the OAuth application.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-redirect_uri: The URL to redirect the user to after authorization. Must match the callback URL registered for the client.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-scope: Space-separated list of permission scopes to request. Should be a subset of the scopes registered for the client. Omit to request all available scopes.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-state: Opaque value used to maintain state between the authorization request and callback, for [CSRF protection](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-10.12).
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-code_challenge: PKCE code challenge derived from the code verifier, used to secure the authorization code flow. Required for non-confidential clients.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-code_challenge_m: The method used to derive the code challenge from the code verifier.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-approval_cancel: Used internally. Clients should not use this field.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-approval_pass: Used internally. Clients should not use this field.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-display: How the authorization dialog UI should be rendered. Set to popup for an embeddable dialog.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-ui_locales: Space-separated list of MediaWiki language codes indicating the user's preferred languages for the authorization UI. (Note that BCP 47 codes which aren't MediaWiki language codes aren't supported.)
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-grant_type: The OAuth 2.0 grant type for the token request (authorization_code, refresh_token or client_credentials).
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-client_secret: The client secret of the OAuth application. Required for the client credentials flow.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-code: The authorization code received from the authorization endpoint.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-refresh_token: A refresh token used to obtain a new access token (and new refresh token) without re-authorizing. The submitted request token will be invalidated after a short grace period.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-code_verifier: PKCE code verifier that was used to generate the code challenge sent in the authorization request.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-limit: Maximum number of clients to return.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-offset: Number of clients to skip, for pagination.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-oauth_version: Filter results by OAuth protocol version.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-name: The name of the OAuth application.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-version: The OAuth protocol version the application uses.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-description: A plaintext description of what the OAuth application does.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-wiki: The ID of the wiki the application is authorized for (e.g. enwiki). Use * for all wikis.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-owner_only: Whether the application is for the owner's personal use only. Owner-only clients receive an access token with infinite validity during registration, and cannot use the authorization and token endpoints.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-callback_url: The URL users are redirected to after authorizing the application.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-callback_is_pref: Whether the callback URL is treated as a prefix, allowing redirects to any URL that starts with it. Only allowed for OAuth 1.0 clients.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-email: Contact email address for the application. Must match the registered email address of the MediaWiki user who is making this request.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-is_confidential: Whether the application is a confidential client that can securely store a client secret.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-grant_types: The OAuth 2.0 grant types the application may use.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-scopes: The permission scopes the application requests access to.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-client_key: The unique key identifying the OAuth application.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-reason: The reason for resetting the client secret.
mwoauth-rest-param-desc-type: The type of resource information to return: profile for OIDC-compatible user information, scopes for a list of the client's scopes.
mwoauth-rest-description-authorize: The OAuth 2.0 [authorization endpoint](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-3.1). Displays the OAuth 2.0 authorization page, where users can grant or deny access to a client. Also processes the authorization decision when the form is submitted.
mwoauth-rest-description-access_token: The OAuth 2.0 [token endpoint](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-3.2). Exchanges an authorization code, refresh token or client credentials for an access token.
mwoauth-rest-description-resource: With type=profile, acts as the OIDC [userinfo endpoint](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html#UserInfo). With type=scope, enumerates the scopes the client has.
mwoauth-rest-description-post-client: Registers a new OAuth 2.0 client application. The API equivalent of Special:OAuthConsumerRegistration/propose/oauth2.
mwoauth-rest-description-client-reset_se: Resets the client secret for an OAuth 2.0 application.
mwoauth-rest-description-get-client: Returns information about the OAuth 1.0 or 2.0 clients registered by the current user.
